title: The size of $k$-th order generalized Fibonacci cubes
summary: Let $k\geq2$. Then the $k$-th order Fibonacci cube $Γ^{(k)}_{n}$ is the subgraph of the hypercube $Q_{n}$ induced by vertices without $k$ consecutive $1$s. The case $k=2$ corresponds to the classic Fibonacci cube $Γ_{n}$. There are three kinds of calculation formulas of the size of $Γ_{n}$: the iteration form $|E(Γ_{n})|=|E(Γ_{n-1})|+|E(Γ_{n-2})|+F_{n}$ (Hsu, 1993), %iteration form the convolution form $|E(Γ_{n})|=\mathop{\sum}\limits_{i=1}^{n}F_{i}F_{n-i+1}$ (Klavžar, 2005) %convolution form and the linear form $|E(Γ_{n})|=\frac{nF_{n+1}+2(n+1)F_{n}}{5}$ (Munarini et al., 2001). %linear…
